**About Us**
At Rox, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.
  
  
Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.
  
  
We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.
  
  
Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.
  
  
Underlying all of this success is an unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.
  
  
The Team
  
  
Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.
  
  
**Members On Our Team Have**

* Founded and exited successful companies
* Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic
* Won IMO and IOI gold medals
* Published field-defining papers

We’re backed by the best, including Sequoia, General Catalyst, Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.
  
  
Core Principles
  
  
Taste: Craft beautiful experiences.
  
  
No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.
  
  
Obsession: Commit unreasonably.
  
  
In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.
  
  
Action: Get it done.
  
  
Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.
  
  
Your Role
  
  
Why This Role Exists
  
  
Foundation models are commoditizing. Defensibility comes from specialized models, proprietary training signals, and evaluation ownership. Every applied AI company we benchmark against like Decagon, Harvey, Sierra, Cursor has already moved. The window to claim frontier applied AI for revenue is closing in the next few months.
  
  
Rox is in market. We run agents against enterprise data at scale, every day. We see exactly where research meets production and where the data is dirty, state is changing, and being wrong costs (a lot of) money. The Applied Research team exists to close that gap permanently.
  
  
What This Team Works On
  
  
**Four Problems We Care About Right Now**
**Cost-efficient inference for Clever Columns.**
Distill a Rox-trained model from frontier teachers so per-account enrichment runs at 1/20th the cost without quality loss. Ships first. Doesn't require trajectory attribution.
  
  
**Signal classification across the public knowledge graph.**
A small, fast classifier that distinguishes genuine buying signals from noise across the news, jobs, and filings corpus we already ingest at scale. Powers Recommended Next Moves and Auto Prospecting. Cleanest data subset.
  
  
**Personalization grounding and hallucination detection.**
A reward model that catches fabricated prospect context in Sequences in real time. This is the most underrated production failure mode in outbound AI. Trained on cross-customer consensus edits.
  
  
**Sequencing policy under sparse, delayed rewards.**
Offline-to-online RL on multi-touch trajectories with intermediate signals as proxies for terminal outcomes. Long-horizon flagship. Hard.
  
  
These are not benchmark problems. They have real SLAs and real customers depending on them.
  
  
Why Join Now
  
  
We are at an unusual moment. Large enough to have real scale, real customers, and genuinely interesting research problems. Small enough that you are one of a handful of people shaping what the Applied Research function looks like and what it prioritizes.
  
  
The team is extraordinary: IMO, IOI, and ICPC medalists, researchers from DeepMind and OpenAI. The feedback loop is a live enterprise system, not a leaderboard. If that's not more interesting to you than publishing for the sake of publishing, this probably isn't the right fit.
  
  
San Francisco, onsite. We relocate exceptional people.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and run research programs tied directly to the four above.
* Build evaluation frameworks that measure trajectory quality, not just final output, because most eval infrastructure measures end results and we care about the path.
* Work on agent memory, retrieval, and context systems alongside elite and competitive engineering minds.
* Translate findings into infrastructure with measurable production impact. Help define where Rox Research goes next.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
First few weeks: you understand Rox's architecture, where the production problems are, and where the research gaps are. You have opinions and you share them.
  
  
First few months: you are running experiments that directly inform how we build. Something you worked on is in production.
  
  
Over time: you are defining the research agenda for the most interesting applied AI problem in the enterprise. The systems you build are things no one else has built before, because no one else has the structural data position to build them.
  
  
**Qualifications**
You have spent real time thinking about how agents fail in practice, not just on benchmarks. You have built evaluation systems and know exactly where standard approaches break down. You can write code well enough to implement your own ideas, run your own experiments, and ship things that make it into production.
  
  
You move fast. The environment changes monthly and the team ships continuously.
  
  
Particularly relevant: agent evaluation and behavioral benchmarking; retrieval-augmented generation and knowledge graph systems; RL applied to real-world agent behavior; production ML systems (latency, reliability, observability); post-training and model adaptation for production use cases.
  
  
A PhD is not required. Strong research instincts and the ability to ship are.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision, including 100% company-paid plans for you and eligible dependents
* Company-paid life & AD&D, plus short- and long-term disability
* 401(k) with automatic enrollment
* Unlimited PTO, plus paid sick leave, company holidays, and bereavement
* Up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave at 100% pay (birth, adoption, or foster)
* Wellness stipend: $375/quarter
* Learning stipend: up to $2,000/year
* Internet & cell phone stipend: $25/month
* Mental health support, virtual care, and care navigation
* Fertility & family-building support, plus backup care membership
* Pre-tax commuter benefits (transit & parking)
* SF HQ: daily catered breakfast & lunch, meal allowances, and rideshare support when commuting to the office

**Overview**
San Mateo hybrid (four days a week in the office) or US remote, with 10 to 30 percent travel. One opening. Pay: $200,000 to $300,000, plus equity.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a ten-person team building AI agents that do real research work, and to be the person who takes them into customers' own systems and makes them work there.
  
  
A customer has a hard problem and messy data. You work out what they actually need, then build and deploy the answer yourself: agents and models running in their environment, plus the integrations and data pipelines that feed them, mostly in Python. You report to the CTO and see the whole thing, from the first conversation to it running live.
  
  
This is for you if you have already done this work: turned a customer's problem into something you built and deployed, and you can talk to the customer in the room as well as write the code. Maybe you held a forward deployed or solutions architect title. Maybe the title was different but the work was the same. We care about what you built.
  
  
The team is small enough that what you ship changes the product, not just one customer's setup.
  
  
Apply now for interviews this week.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Take a customer's requirement or problem and turn it into a working technical solution, built and deployed by you
* Deploy AI agents and ML models inside customer environments
* Build the integrations and data pipelines that feed those agents and models, mostly in Python
* Work directly inside customer systems, not in a sandbox or on cut-down data
* Hold the room with non-engineers: lead the first conversation, understand what the customer actually needs, and stay accountable through to live deployment
* Report to the CTO and own the full arc of each engagement

**Requirements**
**Must-haves:**

* Production code shipped inside a customer's environment
* AI agents, ML models, or custom integrations deployed end-to-end
* Data pipeline experience in Python
* Customer-facing technical work: three or more years
* Four or more years total engineering experience
* Comfortable holding technical and non-technical conversations in the same room
* US-based, with availability for 10-30% travel

**Nice-to-haves:**

* Forward deployed engineer or solutions architect title
* Work that fed back into a core product or was reused across customers
* Experience getting past data access or political blockers at enterprise customers

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* A customer's hard problem is live in production, running in their environment, within weeks of engagement starting
* The customer can name what changed and put a number on it
* Something built for one customer finds its way into the product or another customer's setup
* The CTO has full visibility and no surprises: you surface blockers early and own the outcome
* You've learned a new industry or business domain from scratch and shipped something that worked there

Challenges
  
  

* Customers arrive with vague problems and messy data: you define the solution yourself, there is no spec handed to you
* The team is ten people, so ambiguity is the default and the playbook is yours to write
* Getting access to the data and systems you need often means winning over people who did not ask for this project
* Travel is real: 10-30% of your time, on customer sites, sometimes in unfamiliar industries

**About The Role**
The role centers on building and operating the backend systems that power the company's core product - APIs, services, and data pipelines that handle real traffic at real scale.
  
  
You will work closely with frontend and mobile engineers to define contracts and ship features, and with infrastructure teams to keep systems fast, observable, and reliable.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain RESTful and gRPC services in Go, Python, or Node.js that serve production traffic
* Own the full lifecycle of backend features - schema design, implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration based on real-world usage
* Model and optimize relational and non-relational data stores (PostgreSQL, Redis, DynamoDB) for correctness and performance
* Build event-driven workflows using message queues and streaming systems such as Kafka or SQS
* Improve reliability and observability: instrument services with metrics, tracing, and alerting; participate in on-call rotation and incident reviews
* Collaborate with frontend and mobile engineers on API design, versioning, and backward-compatible contract changes
* Write clean, tested, well-documented code and contribute to design reviews and team engineering standards

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3–6 years of backend or full-stack software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building production services
* Deep proficiency in at least one backend language: Go, Python, Java, or Node.js/TypeScript
* Strong SQL and data modeling skills; hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or a comparable relational database
* Experience deploying and operating services on AWS, GCP, or Azure (containers, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code)
* Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: idempotency, caching, retries, consistency tradeoffs, and graceful degradation
* BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* Bonus: experience with Kubernetes and Terraform, prior work on high-throughput APIs, or contributions to open-source backend tooling

**About The Company**
Conviva is the experience analytics platform for AI agents, applications, and streaming media. As a pioneer in quality of experience measurement for streaming video, Conviva has supported live digital experiences across major global events including 20 Super Bowls, 10 Olympic Games, and five FIFA World Cup tournaments. The platform delivers full-census, real-time, stateful analytics that reveal what consumers actually experience, going beyond system uptime to connect user experience directly to business outcomes such as revenue, retention, and risk mitigation.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a talented AI/ML Engineer with strong fundamentals in machine learning and hands-on experience in model development, training, and evaluation. The successful candidate will address challenging real-world problems by transforming research and experimentation into practical, scalable solutions. This role involves ownership of key stages in the machine learning development lifecycle, including data preparation, model design, training, evaluation, debugging, and iterative improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate goes beyond implementing existing methods by deeply understanding problems, evaluating alternative solutions, making informed technical decisions, and systematically investigating model performance. Collaboration with engineering and product teams is essential to explore new ML approaches, develop effective models, and build the infrastructure necessary for scalable experimentation and deployment.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* PhD preferred in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field. Recent PhD graduates with strong research experience are encouraged to apply.
* Strong foundation in machine learning, deep learning, probability, statistics, algorithms, and data structures.
* Hands-on experience developing and training ML models through academic research or industry projects.
* Proficiency with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Comprehensive understanding of the ML development lifecycle including data preparation, model training, experimental design, evaluation methodology, and error analysis.
* Strong programming skills in Python, C++, or other relevant programming languages.
* Ability to independently investigate complex technical problems, design experiments, and communicate findings clearly.
* Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to explore new techniques.
* Good English communication skills.
* Nice to Have:
* Research publications at leading conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, or other relevant venues.
* Experience with reinforcement learning, deep learning, LLM fine-tuning, pre-training, or post-training techniques.
* Experience with large-scale model training, distributed training, or ML systems optimization.
* Experience deploying ML models into production or developing ML infrastructure including model serving, monitoring, and MLOps.
* Familiarity with large-scale data processing frameworks such as Spark or Flink.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, train, and evaluate machine learning models to solve complex real-world problems.
* Own the end-to-end ML development lifecycle including dataset construction, model design, training, experimentation, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Explore and apply modern ML techniques such as deep learning, reinforcement learning, and large language model training or fine-tuning as appropriate.
* Design rigorous experiments, define meaningful evaluation metrics, establish baselines, and analyze model performance to guide technical decisions.
* Translate research ideas into practical solutions through close collaboration with engineering and product teams.
* Contribute to ML tooling, data pipelines, and infrastructure that support efficient experimentation and scalable model development.
* Take ownership of technical challenges, proactively investigate new approaches, and continuously improve model quality and reliability.
